Shanghai Municipal Council.
June 28th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
General Yang received a long letter from Admiral
Lee Ting Sing 李鼎新 on 27th instant in which the latter
stated that the navy had declared independence and that
he had been selected to take supreme command. He
invited General Yang to follow the example of the navy.
On receipt of the above letter General Yang sent for
Deputy Military Governor Lu Yung Ziang (Woosung) and they
had a long consultation after which the former dispatched
telegrams to Nanking and Peking. It is said that General
Lu strongly opposes the action of the navy and will fight
rather than declare independence.
It is reported that several Kuomintang leaders
including Nyeu Tih Sung 鈕永建 Han Hwei 韓恢 and Ho Hai
Ming 何海鳴 are present on board the warships outside
Woosung.
It is reported that Chekiang will cooperate with
the navy in any action it takes.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

[签名]
Captain Superintendent of Police.

[签名]

E.. [手写批注，难以辨认] June 28
[手写批注，难以辨认]

上海工部局。
1916年6月28日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生，
杨将军于本月27日收到海军上将李鼎新的一封长信，信中称海军已宣布独立，并推举他担任最高指挥官。他邀请杨将军效仿海军之举。收到上述信件后，杨将军召见淞沪护军使卢永祥（吴淞），两人进行了长时间磋商，随后前者向南京和北京发出了电报。据悉，卢将军强烈反对海军的行动，宁可作战也不愿宣布独立。
据报，包括钮永建、韩恢和何海鸣在内的几位国民党领导人目前身处吴淞外的军舰上。
据报，浙江将在海军采取的任何行动中予以配合。

您的顺从仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

[签名]
警务总监。

[签名]

E.. [手写批注，难以辨认] 6月28日
[手写批注，难以辨认]
